**What do you want to ask Claude that does not work today?**
e.g. "Show the USD rate for every day of last month."

**Proposed change**
New tool, new optional field, or behaviour change. Note that existing tool names and fields must
stay backward compatible.

**Upstream data**
Which NBU endpoint provides the data, if you know it (https://bank.gov.ua/ua/open-data/api-dev).
